project_title: Racontelle Family Memory App - Fingerprint Biometric Auth & Quick Unlock

theme.description: Warm, nostalgic, family-heritage aesthetic with soft cream backgrounds (#FDFBF7), vintage muted terracotta/rose accents (#C98B8B, #B57477), sage green highlights (#738A70), and elegant display typography (Cormorant Garamond) combined with legibility body fonts (DM Sans).

rules.headings: Use Cormorant Garamond / CormorantSemiBold for high emotional storytelling hierarchy (Titles, Lock Screen Greetings, Security Modal Headings)
rules.body: Use DM Sans / DMSansMedium for maximum legibility on mobile screens (Status hints, Error banners, Settings toggles, PIN prompt descriptions)
rules.max_heading_size: 32px on mobile to avoid layout breaking
rules.hierarchy: Header 24px-28px Cormorant, Subtitle 16px DMSansMedium, Label/Caption 12px-14px uppercase tracking-wider

layout_and_spacing.container_padding: 16px horizontal, 24px vertical with safe area insets consideration

lock_screen_layout.hero_avatar: Centred warm family emblem or user profile avatar surrounded by subtle brand ring (#C98B8B)
lock_screen_layout.fingerprint_trigger_card: Interactive card/button with pulsing biometric fingerprint icon (#B57477) and tactile feedback
lock_screen_layout.fallback_actions: Secondary button for 'Utiliser le code / PIN du téléphone' and text link for 'Se connecter avec e-mail et mot de passe'

biometric_unlock_blueprint.flow_description: Enables rapid fingerprint biometric unlock for returning users without re-entering email and password.

key_functionalities.name: Hardware & Enrollment Detection
key_functionalities.details: Verifies hardware support (isEnrolled / hasHardware via expo-local-authentication or navigator.credentials). Sets state to unsupported / not enrolled gracefully.

key_functionalities.name: Activation Post First Login
key_functionalities.details: After successful email/password auth, prompts user to enable fingerprint unlock or automatically registers saved auth token for quick biometric resume.

key_functionalities.name: App Resume Lock Screen
key_functionalities.details: When app returns from background or launches with an active stored session and biometrics enabled, displays the Lock Screen requiring fingerprint/PIN verification.

key_functionalities.name: Fallback to Phone PIN
key_functionalities.details: If fingerprint authentication fails or user requests system backup, triggers phone fallback (fallbackToPin / device passcode authentication).

key_functionalities.name: Email & Password Alternative
key_functionalities.details: Always provides a direct route back to full credential login ('Se connecter avec e-mail/mot de passe').

key_functionalities.name: Profile Security Toggle
key_functionalities.details: Dedicated setting in Profile ('Déverrouillage par empreinte digitale') allowing users to enable/disable biometrics anytime.

key_functionalities.name: Session Expiration & Cancellation Handling
key_functionalities.details: Handles cancelled attempts without locking user out; clears biometric session and redirects to full login if auth token is expired.

key_functionalities.name: Web Compatibility
key_functionalities.details: Safely ignores native biometric prompts on web or relies on WebAuthn if supported, ensuring unchanged web functionality.

lock_screen_view.location: app/(auth)/lock-screen.tsx or embedded LockScreen overlay in auth navigator
lock_screen_view.title: Déverrouillage Biométrique
lock_screen_view.description: Lock screen rendered when user opens app with an active cached session and biometric unlock enabled.

profile_biometric_settings_section.title: Sécurité & Biométrie
profile_biometric_settings_section.description: Profile tab section providing toggle switch for enabling or disabling fingerprint unlock.

login_screen_biometric_prompt.title: Proposer Empreinte après Connexion
login_screen_biometric_prompt.description: Post-login prompt or quick biometric setup banner offering user to activate fingerprint unlock for future sessions.

vintage_family_1.description: Family photo header background for memory album and lock screen header

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_rules: All interactive biometric triggers, PIN fallback links, setting toggles, error banners, and password buttons MUST contain explicit data-testid or testID attributes in kebab-case format.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text against warm background #FDFBF7

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always preserve existing warm Racontelle design tokens (#FDFBF7 surface, #C98B8B brand rose, #738A70 sage green, Cormorant font for titles).
Integrate fingerprint biometric unlock natively with expo-local-authentication fallback logic.
Display Lock Screen when reopening app with an existing active token and biometric preference set to true.
Provide system PIN fallback button ('Utiliser le code / PIN du téléphone') when biometric verification fails.
Always maintain a clean escape route to full email/password login ('Se connecter avec e-mail et mot de passe').
Ensure toggle in Profile screen allows enabling and disabling fingerprint unlock seamlessly with state saved to secure storage.
Gracefully present informative states for: hardware not supported, no fingerprint enrolled, user cancelled, or session token expired.
Keep Web application flow unchanged and error-free when native biometric modules are absent.
Maintain complete data-testid attributes across all lock screen and security profile elements for automated testing.
